description: A rounded rectangular speech bubble with a tail at its lower left, its outline broken into two arrows: a downward arrow on the left side and an upward arrow on the right, circling the bubble anticlockwise.
A rounded rectangular speech bubble with an empty interior and a short pointed tail dropping from the left part of its lower edge.
A rounded rectangular speech bubble with a tail at its lower left. Its top edge breaks near the left, where a left-pointing arrowhead turns the outline back toward the upper-left corner.
